scientific_scope_status: For explicit trace-preserving conditional expectations on fixed matrix algebras M_(r^3), the completely bounded commutator tends to zero as r grows, while every exactly commuting repaired pair onto unital subalgebras of the same ambient algebra remains at distance >=(1-r^-1/2)/4. Ambient algebra, norm, trace, maps and allowed repair are essential. Ancillas, discarded environments, marginal return and joint return can change the result; no physical impossibility or free catalytic operation follows. Exact-formulation novelty UNKNOWN.
